job: Put three to five main destinations one thumb-press away at the bottom of a phone.
purpose: A bar fixed to the bottom of the app shell with an icon and a short label for each destination. It shows only while the shell is under 640px wide; above that the sidebar or the menu sheet serves. A "More" item opens the menu sheet with the rest of the navigation. A count or a dot marks an item that has something new.
useWhen: A phone product has three to five places people move between all day.
The menu sheet alone buries the main destinations behind a tap.
Something new on a destination should show without opening it.

avoidWhen.when: There are more than five destinations and no clear main few.
The app is for a desktop or a wide window.
The buttons run actions on the page rather than go to places.
The page is a website, not an app.
avoidWhen.instead: A site header with links, as on the docs pages.

states.name: current
states.how: aria-current="page" on the item for the page; the accent colour and a stronger icon

states.name: menu open
states.how: aria-expanded="true" on the "More" item while the sheet is open; set by shell.js

states.name: count
states.how: a fd-tabbar-badge in the item, read with its label

states.name: new
states.how: data-dot on the item, with an fd-sr-only line that says what is new

variants.useWhen: An item has something new but no number to show.

parts.role: The bar: a nav with aria-label="Primary", a direct child of fd-app.
One destination: a link, or a button with data-fd-mobile-nav and aria-controls for "More"; an icon and a label.
The one-word label under the icon; it truncates, never wraps.

keyboard.does: Moves between the items; they are links and a button, not ARIA tabs.
Follows a link; on "More", opens or closes the menu sheet.
